title: Proper-open comparison for complexes from the etale site
statement:
Let $u:T_1\to T_2$ be a
proper morphism between
Noetherian schemes, and $j_i:X\hookrightarrow T_i$
open immersions with
$u j_1=j_2$. Fix a finite coefficient ring
$\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, and a
bounded-below etale complex
$L\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$.
Writing $K=\nu_X^*L$ for pullback along
the comparison
morphism, there is a canonical isomorphism on the pro-etale site

$$
j_{2!}K\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_*j_{1!}K.
$$

Here $j_!$ is
extension by zero and
$Ru_*$ is the
derived direct image.
These maps are the identity for the identity proper map and commute
with composition of proper maps fixing $X$.

The schemes and morphism properties are those of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Here a Noetherian scheme means one admitting a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. The coefficient notation is that of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]: $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$, for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$. The coefficient ring is used through its constant sheaf of rings on each site; the objects of the derived categories are sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, not necessarily constant sheaves. Use [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] on the etale site, [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] for the ordinary, uncompleted pro-etale derived direct image, [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] for $\nu$, and [def-weil-extension-by-zero] for the pro-etale $j_!$.

proof.text: Write N_i = nu_T_i^*, N_X = nu_X^*, J_i = j_i! on the etale site, and P_i = j_i! on the pro-etale site. Use the existing natural sheaf isomorphism openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Retain [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level], which realizes step 3 of unit sk-prop-pe-comparison-morphism, for the finite-level comparison exactness. The public fixed-module sheaf interfaces supply the exactness instances for these functors; etale extension exactness is [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]. The exact-functor derived construction [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated], with bounded-below restriction [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below], turns this into delta_i : J_i followed by N_i isomorphic to N_X followed by P_i. Explicitly compose the inverse derived-composition isomorphism, mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso of the sheaf comparison, and the derived-composition isomorphism. This is properOpenSiteExtensionIso. Localization and descent are already performed by these existing exact-functor APIs; no separate localization construction is needed here.

proof.text: Define properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus as delta_2 inverse, followed by N_2(alpha_r), the canonical derived direct-image comparison at J_1 L, and Rr_proet,*(delta_1). All four factors are isomorphisms by steps 1 and 2. Define the ambient properOpenProEtaleIso by transporting this bounded-below isomorphism through the existing mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility and rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility isomorphisms for the inclusion into the unbounded category. These are explicit composites of the prescribed isomorphisms, without choosing any new data.

proof.text: For r : T_1 -> T_2 and s : T_2 -> T_3, proper composition is [lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition]. Expand the four factors of properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus for r, s, and r followed by s. Substitute properOpenComparison_comp from [lem-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison-composition]. Apply comparisonDirectImagePlus_comp from [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image] at J_1 L. Naturality of the comparison for s moves N_3(Rs_et,*(alpha_r)) through that comparison. Naturality of proEtaleComparisonDirectImageCompIso moves delta_1 through the direct-image compositor. On the other side, functoriality and delta_2.hom followed by delta_2.inv cancel the two middle extension factors. Associativity gives exactly properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus_comp. For the identity, naturality of the canonical right-derived identity identification moves delta.hom to the end. Apply comparisonDirectImagePlus_id, map the identity law properOpenComparison_id, and cancel delta.inv followed by delta.hom. This proves properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus_id. All calculations take place in the given bounded-below derived categories.
